capabilities: create a folder named after a note and move the note into it
automatically rename or move the folder whenever the folder note is renamed or moved
update links to notes that were moved along with the folder
detach a folder note by renaming the folder and moving the note out
extras: Warns that enabling the Folder Note plugin's auto-rename at the same time can cause rename loops or broken links; gives exact settings (Note File Method: 'Folder Name Inside', Auto Rename: OFF) to use both plugins together.
problem: Obsidian treats notes and folders as separate items, so when a topic note outgrows itself, turning it into a folder with sub-notes means manually keeping the folder and note in sync on every move or rename.
summary: Adds a command that turns a note into a folder note and keeps the folder renamed or moved in step with that note.
